context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 138 verified three new features for Loan Given: (1) Cascade Delete: When DELETE /api/investments/{id} is called for a Loan Given investment, the backend correctly deletes the linked income_source (by linkedIncomeSourceId), all investment_transactions (by investmentId), and income_received entries (by entityId=linkedIncomeSourceId). (2) Confirm/Reject Repayment: POST /api/investments/confirm-repayment/{notification_id} endpoint works correctly - action=confirm marks the auto-recorded transaction as confirmed and notification as read; action=reject rolls back the investment amounts (restores amountReceived, outstandingAmount, currentValue, loanStatus to pre-repayment state), deletes the transaction, and marks notification. (3) Scheduler: auto_process_loan_repayments() is called daily in the scheduler loop and creates notifications with requiresConfirmation=true for loans with fixed repayment plans due today.
